note: Wooded 13-acre campground on the south edge of Luverne, a quarter mile south of Luverne City Park and 2.5 miles from I-90, with two small catch-and-release fishing ponds and the paved Ashby Trail to the Luverne Loop and Blue Mounds bike trails. Mostly long-stay: the full-hookup and back-in sites are taken for the summer, and the water/electric pull-throughs are the ones sold by the night. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Hipcamp + Google read: 18 sites (12 pull-through, 9 FHU), 20/30/50 amp; $35 operator rate ($40-48 all-in on Hipcamp); private gates pass (under $50, own website + Hipcamp booking, Google 4.6/58). Long-stay: 11 of 18 sites never open on three 2027 weeknights May-Aug; the 7 W/E pull-throughs are the nightly pool (39%) - passes, but reads as mostly long-stay; note says so. Not waterfront kept; pin OK.
flags: Private gates: operator rate $35 ('excluding holidays/holiday weekends'); Hipcamp all-in $40 (2027-05-11) and $48 (2027-06-15, 2027-08-17), all under $50. Presence: own website (Wix) with phone, email and Hipcamp booking. Google Maps 4.6 stars, 58 reviews, phone +1 507-935-5384, website riverroadcampgroundluverne.com.

Long-stay five tests (weekly/monthly marketed: 'For extended stay, contact us for details on weekly/monthly rates'): (1) $35-48 a night, pass; (2) nightly rate posted and instant-book online, pass; (3) minimum 1 night, pass; (4) nightly share: on Hipcamp the same 11 sites (FHU 12-17, back-ins 1-4 and 18) were 'Unavailable' on 2027-05-11, 06-15 and 08-17 while the 7 water/electric pull-throughs 5-11 were open, so about 7 of 18 (39%) sell by the night, over 1 in 10, pass; (5) no homes or lots sold (a rental house and cabin on the property), pass. Reads as MOSTLY LONG-STAY (11 of 18 held all summer); the note says so. A Hipcamp review: 'There are seasonal? campers there and they come in from 5 to after dark, and they leave early too.' Google 4.6/58 - not iffy, so not an automatic drop.
Fees: stored $35 confirmed; a 23-ft motorhome fits the open pull-throughs (Hipcamp 'Vehicles under 45 ft'). Hipcamp's all-in prices run $5-13 over the operator's rate.
Sites: max_rig_ft 40 (derived) -> 45 from Hipcamp's per-site 'Vehicles under 45 ft'. Operator says 9 FHU; Hipcamp names 6 (12-17).

Waterfront: not waterfront kept. The operator's 'Two small ponds just around the bend' (catch-and-release; sizes not measured here) and the Rock River about 1/4 mile away; stored evidence calls the pond a small field pond across the road.
Season: closed in winter; exact open/close dates not posted - Hipcamp shows nothing on 2027-04-06 or 2027-10-26 and sites from 2027-05-11 to at least 08-17. Opens/closes left unset.

Phone 507-935-5384 and website https://www.riverroadcampgroundluverne.com/ confirmed; add the Hipcamp booking link https://www.hipcamp.com/en-US/land/minnesota-river-road-campground-luverne-88lhr8lw as a second line if wanted (it is the operator's own Reservations link).
